{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your {c_important}Summons'{/c} damage afflict enemies with {c_important}{u}Vampiric Curse{/u}{/c}. Consuming a Corpse also contributes {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} souls to {c_important}{u}Vampiric Curse{/u}{/c}, which can now stack up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} souls.

Only {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} can now unleash the souls from {c_important}{u}Vampiric Curse{/u}{/c}, causing both {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} and the souls to deal {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|x%1|]{/c} increased damage per soul unleashed.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
